desc:
🌆 WELCOME TO OUTSIDE!

The streets are yours. What you do with them is up to you.

🔥 OUTSIDE is an urban PvP experience inspired by the FiveM pvp scene. Jump into the city, get into intense gunfights, build your reputation, and prove yourself against other players.

⚔️ Take part in intense street PvP and gunfights
🔫 Use a variety of weapons and fight your way to the top
👥 Create a crew, recruit your friends, and build your reputation
🏆 Compete in Facechecks and large-scale Crew Wars
💰 Earn cash and work your way up
🚗 Explore the city and customize your ride
👑 Dominate the streets and make a name for yourself

YOUR CREW. YOUR REP. YOUR CITY.

📢 BETA RELEASE: OUTSIDE is still in development! Expect bugs, unfinished features, balance changes, and regular updates as we continue building the experience.

More content, new features, expansions, and experiences are on the way.

THE STREETS ARE CALLING. GET OUTSIDE. 🔥
